claim_1.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of CD8+ effector memory T cells from blood, bone marrow, spleen, lung, and lymph nodes from multiple organ donors (n=6-11) showed that lymph node memory CD8+ T cells exhibited significantly higher TCF-1 expression and enhanced proliferative capacity to TCR-mediated stimulation compared to memory T cells from other tissue sites.

sources.quote: In all donors, TCF-1 expression by CD8+TEM in LN was significantly higher than that found in CD8+TEM derived from blood, BM, spleen, and lung
When stimulated with anti-CD3/anti-CD28 antibodies, LN memory CD8+T cells exhibited greater proliferation compared to counterparts in BM, spleen and lung

comparison.finding: significantly higher TCF-1 expression in LN vs blood memory CD8+ T cells
significantly higher TCF-1 expression and enhanced proliferative capacity in LN vs BM memory CD8+ T cells
significantly higher TCF-1 expression in LN vs spleen memory CD8+ T cells
significantly higher TCF-1 expression in LN vs lung memory CD8+ T cells

claim_2.claim: CyTOF analysis of CD8+ T cells from lymph nodes, bone marrow, spleen, and lung from three organ donors showed that lymph node memory CD8+ T cells exhibit a distinct protein expression signature characterized by elevated TCF-1, CD28, CXCR4, and CXCR5 with reduced T-bet and Granzyme B compared to memory T cells from other tissue sites.

sources.quote: In LN, CD8+TEM occupied a distinct region of the tSNE, showing overlap with CD8+TEM from spleen but not from BM and lung
LN memory CD8+T cells express a unique combination of markers—including those shared with naïve T cells (cluster I & IV), and others with memory CD8+T cells in blood and other sites

comparison.finding: distinct protein expression signature with elevated TCF-1, CD28, CXCR4, CXCR5 and reduced T-bet, Granzyme B in LN vs BM memory CD8+ T cells
distinct protein expression signature with elevated TCF-1, CD28, CXCR4, CXCR5 and reduced T-bet, Granzyme B in LN vs spleen memory CD8+ T cells
distinct protein expression signature with elevated TCF-1, CD28, CXCR4, CXCR5 and reduced T-bet, Granzyme B in LN vs lung memory CD8+ T cells

claim_3.claim: RNA-seq analysis of sorted CD8+ effector memory T cells from blood, bone marrow, spleen, lung, and lymph nodes from nine individuals showed that lymph node memory CD8+ T cells exhibit a distinct transcriptional signature with upregulated self-renewal factors (TCF-1/TCF7, LEF-1), Tfh-associated markers (CXCR5, CXCR4, BCL-6), and downregulated effector molecules (GZMA, PRF1) compared to memory T cells from other tissue sites.

sources.quote: LN memory CD8+T cells had increased expression of transcripts associated with self-renewal (LEF-1, TCF-7), follicular helper T (Tfh) cell differentiation (BCL-6, CXCR5, CXCR4, CCR7), co-stimulation (CD28, ICOS), and reduced expression of effector transcripts (GZMA, PRF1)

Based on the DE genes derived from Fig. 2A, the transcriptional profile of LN memory CD8+T cells clustered together by principle component analysis (PCA), distinct from that of memory CD8+T cells in blood, BM, spleen and lung for all donors analyzed

claim_4.claim: T cell receptor sequencing analysis of memory CD8+ T cells from bone marrow and lymph nodes from five organ donors showed that lymph node memory CD8+ T cells maintain significantly higher TCR clonal diversity and lower clonality compared to memory T cells from bone marrow.

sources.quote: BM memory CD8+T cells consistently had higher clonality compared to LN memory CD8+T cells
Conversely, an increase in TCR diversity was observed for LN compared to BM memory CD8+T cells for all donors even when controlling for clone size

comparison.finding: significantly higher TCR clonal diversity and lower clonality in LN vs BM memory CD8+ T cells
